title: Easy Samples Are All You Need: Self-Evolving LLMs via Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Zhiyin Yu, Bo Zhang, Qibin Hou, Zhonghai Wu, Xiao Luo, Lei Bai
paper_type_zh: 渐进式伪标注选择与强化学习研究
best_for_zh: 适合把小规模已验证种子集和大量困难无标注池转化为分阶段推理训练课程的读者。
one_line: EasyRL grows a GRPO training set from a few easy labels by selecting consistent or reflection-resolved pseudo-labels from progressively harder problems.
EasyRL 从少量简单标注题出发，逐步选择一致或经反思解决的伪标注难题来扩展 GRPO 训练集。
why: It makes pseudo-label acceptance and deferral an explicit training-data decision instead of treating every unlabeled example as equally ready for RL.
inclusion_reason: It changes how scarce labeled examples and progressively selected pseudo-labeled examples are consumed by RL, using uncertainty to decide which harder records are safe to add next.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reliable labels are easier to obtain for simple reasoning problems than for difficult ones, while directly training on a large difficult unlabeled pool risks noisy pseudo-labels, reward hacking, and collapse. A static confidence filter either admits too much noise or leaves most hard data unused. The training question is therefore not only how to generate pseudo-labels, but when each uncertain record should become training supervision.

The paper asks whether a model can use a small easy labeled set to grow into harder reasoning data without assuming that every generated answer is trustworthy. It seeks a staged consumer of unlabeled records: accept cases already supported by repeated agreement, spend reflection effort on intermediate uncertainty, and postpone cases beyond the current policy's reliable frontier.

简单推理题比困难题更容易获得可靠标注，而直接在大量困难无标注池上训练会面临带噪伪标注、奖励投机和模型坍塌。静态置信度过滤要么接纳过多噪声，要么让大部分难题始终无法使用。因此训练问题不只是如何生成伪标注，更是每条不确定记录何时应成为训练监督。

论文要回答的是，模型能否利用少量简单标注题逐步走向更难的推理数据，同时不假定每个生成答案都可信。它要构造一种分阶段的数据消费者：接纳已由重复一致性支持的例子，对中等不确定性投入反思成本，并推迟超出当前策略可靠边界的例子。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
EasyRL first uses easy verified examples to make a warm-up policy, then uses that policy to assign the hard pool to uncertainty bands. Identical answers from repeated attempts are accepted as low-uncertainty pseudo-labels. Inconsistent answers receive an entropy test and, when sufficiently concentrated, a reflection-based resolution; highly uncertain examples are not discarded permanently but reserved for later rounds.

The selected pseudo-labels are mixed with the original labels for another GRPO stage. The stronger policy then re-labels the deferred pool, so the records entering training become harder as its reliability improves. This turns pseudo-label selection, reflection, and deferral into a curriculum rather than a one-shot synthetic-data release.

EasyRL 先利用简单的已验证例子得到热身策略，再让该策略把困难题池划入不同不确定性区间。多次尝试得到完全相同答案的样本，会作为低不确定性伪标注被接纳；答案不一致的样本接受熵检验，若分布足够集中则通过反思解决；高度不确定的例子不会被永久丢弃，而是留到后续轮次。

所选伪标注会与原始标注混合，进入下一阶段 GRPO。更强的策略再为此前被推迟的数据打标，因此随着可靠性提高，实际进入训练的记录会变得更难。这使伪标注选择、反思与推迟共同构成一套课程，而不是一次性的合成数据发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reported training pool contains 20K DeepMath-103K problems: 2K labeled examples at difficulty 3.0–4.5 and 18K unlabeled examples at difficulty 5.0–10.0. A GRPO warm-up uses answer verification and boxed-format penalties. For each hard problem, the model makes two inferences; equal answers are selected immediately, while inconsistent answers with entropy at most 0.3 are passed to a reflection prompt that chooses or re-solves an answer.

Each round trains GRPO on the easy labels plus selected pseudo-labels, then repeats generation and selection on the deferred remainder. The paper uses a 4096-token maximum sequence length and evaluates Qwen2.5-Math 1.5B and 7B plus Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. Its selection rule is therefore coupled to the current policy, but its training reward for selected hard data is agreement with a generated pseudo-label rather than an external answer key.

论文报告的训练池含 2 万道 DeepMath-103K 题目：难度 3.0–4.5 的 2 千道有标注题，以及难度 5.0–10.0 的 1.8 万道无标注题。GRPO 热身使用答案验证和方框格式惩罚。对每道难题，模型进行两次推理；答案相同的样本立即被选择，答案不一致但熵不超过 0.3 的样本则交给反思提示，由它选择或重新求解答案。

每一轮都在简单标注题与所选伪标注题上训练 GRPO，随后在被推迟的剩余池上重复生成与选择。论文使用 4096 的最大序列长度，并评测 Qwen2.5-Math 1.5B、7B 和 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct。因而选择规则与当前策略相连，但被选难题的训练奖励来自与生成伪标注的一致性，而非外部答案键。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the mathematical benchmarks, the paper reports that the third EasyRL iteration improves Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B's five-task average to 40.3 and Qwen2.5-Math-7B's to 50.6. With 10 percent easy labeled data, those figures exceed the reported full-label supervised GRPO averages of 39.5 and 49.5. The same table shows improvements over the base model on scientific biology, chemistry, and physics tasks, although those are transfer measurements rather than direct training data.

The ablation removes knowledge transfer, divide-and-conquer pseudo-labeling, or difficulty-progressive self-training and reports average drops across two models. The paper also tracks the selected data over iterations: selected average difficulty rises, while repeated self-training eventually converges and can slightly decline after the third round. These analyses support the staged selection claim, but they do not independently verify pseudo-label correctness for every selected record.

在数学基准上，论文报告第三轮 EasyRL 将 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 的五任务平均分提升到 40.3，将 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 提升到 50.6。在只使用 10% 简单标注数据时，这两个数值超过了所报告的全标注监督 GRPO 平均分 39.5 和 49.5。相同表格也显示基础模型在生物、化学和物理科学任务上有所提升，不过这些属于迁移测量，而不是直接训练数据。

消融实验分别移除知识迁移、分而治之的伪标注或难度渐进自训练，并报告两个模型上的平均下降。论文还追踪了各轮所选数据：被选样本的平均难度上升，而重复自训练最终会收敛，并在第三轮之后略有下降。这些分析支持分阶段选择的主张，但并未独立验证每条被选伪标注的正确性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive choice is not simply easy-to-hard ordering. Easy examples are used as a trusted seed, while harder examples are admitted according to the current model's agreement and uncertainty structure. The method differentiates accepting, reflecting on, and deferring records, so the hard pool is a source of evolving supervision rather than an undifferentiated reward-free corpus.

It also makes pseudo-label quality a training-state variable. A record that is too uncertain in one round can become eligible after the policy is strengthened on easier selected records. This changes the data consumer over time and gives a concrete operational interpretation to a learning frontier, though the frontier is estimated by self-consistency and reflection rather than by a ground-truth verifier for the hard pool.

独特之处不只是由易到难的排序。简单例子被当作可信种子，而困难例子是否接纳取决于当前模型的答案一致性和不确定性结构。方法区分接纳、反思和推迟记录，因此困难题池成为不断演化的监督来源，而不是一个未加区分、没有奖励的语料库。

它还把伪标注质量变成训练状态变量。一条在某一轮过于不确定的记录，可能在策略先通过较容易的已选记录变强后变得可用。这会随时间改变数据消费者，并为学习边界给出具体操作化解释；不过该边界由自一致性和反思估计，而不是由困难题池的真实验证器确定。

title: Limitations
局限
html: EasyRL is tested mainly where answers can be checked or represented as discrete pseudo-labels; the authors explicitly leave open-ended, non-verifiable tasks for future work. Self-training can accumulate pseudo-label errors, and the paper observes convergence or slight decline after repeated rounds. Its acceptance thresholds, source difficulty labels, reflection behavior, and initial easy seed all affect which records become supervision, while the paper does not release the resulting pseudo-label sets for direct audit.
EasyRL 主要在答案可检查或可表示为离散伪标注的场景中测试；作者明确把开放式、不可验证任务留作未来工作。自训练可能累积伪标注错误，论文也观察到多轮之后会收敛或略有下降。接纳阈值、源数据的难度标注、反思行为和初始简单种子都会影响哪些记录成为监督，而论文没有发布得到的伪标注集合供直接审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when verified data is scarce but a difficult unlabeled pool can be revisited across training rounds. Its reusable pattern is to separate trusted seed supervision from conditional pseudo-label admission, and to keep an explicit deferred set instead of forcing every low-confidence example into the next update. A deployment should independently audit pseudo-label error, establish a stopping rule, and replace the paper's entropy and difficulty choices with domain-specific calibration.
当已验证数据稀缺、但困难无标注池可以跨多个训练轮次反复访问时，可以使用这项工作。其可复用模式是把可信种子监督与有条件的伪标注接纳分开，并保留一个明确的推迟集合，而不是强迫每个低置信度例子进入下一次更新。实际部署应独立审计伪标注错误，建立停止规则，并以领域专用的校准替换论文中的熵与难度选择。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read EasyRL as a rule for admitting synthetic supervision, not as evidence that easy examples alone are enough. Follow the three transitions: verified easy labels create the warm-up policy, uncertainty partitions the hard pool, and later checkpoints reconsider the deferred portion. The crucial audit question is whether agreement and reflection are sufficiently correlated with correctness for the intended domain, because the later GRPO stages optimize against pseudo-labels rather than ground truth.
应把 EasyRL 视为接纳合成监督的规则，而不是简单例子本身就足够的证据。请追踪三个转换：已验证的简单标注建立热身策略，不确定性把困难题池分区，后续检查点重新考虑被推迟的部分。关键审计问题是，一致性和反思是否与目标领域的正确性足够相关，因为后续 GRPO 阶段优化的是伪标注，而不是真实答案。
